notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
Thanks for all your activity and kind words — I really appreciate your support.
[h1]In this update:[/h1]
- Removed the traffic light mechanic (got a lot of negative feedback).
- Also polished the girls' eye movements — now they blink naturally and show more emotion.
Thanks again, and enjoy the game! 🚀
